clues.name: The Saucer
clues.context: Flipped over in a puddle of milk.
clues.inspectorDescription: A saucer, upside down in its own puddle. It did not do this by itself.

clues.name: The Water Bowl
clues.context: Full, upright, not a drop spilled.
clues.inspectorDescription: Untouched. A clue can be true and still not be the answer.

clues.name: The Kitten
clues.context: Sitting right next to the puddle.
clues.inspectorDescription: A very small cat with very milky whiskers, looking very innocent.

clues.name: The Old Dog
clues.inspectorDescription: Snoring. He has not moved in hours - the rug still has his shape.

clues.name: The Zoomies
clues.inspectorDescription: That burst of wild energy that sends a small cat crashing into everything.

clues.name: Hunger
clues.context: The old dog is always hungry.
clues.inspectorDescription: A fine motive for a dog. This dog, however, is asleep.

finalSolveSentence: So, the whole story: [The kitten] knocked over [the saucer] because of [the zoomies].
